about: DeviceHub's built-in never list (22 Oct 2026), read by helpers/declarative-driver.mjs validate(). A driver.json whose message templates could produce any of these byte patterns is refused. Collected only from the 'Read-only first' / 'Never' sections of docs/brands/*.md (each entry names its sheet and the open project the sheet cites). bytes: the data bytes after the report id, from the first one; ?? matches any byte. reportId: only messages sent on that report id. within: the pattern may also start this many bytes later (framing not documented). vid / pids / page: which devices the entry is about (vid '*' = any). An entry with bytes null is documented but has no byte pattern; refuseVendors refuses a whole vendor's driver.json.

refuseVendors.why: HID++ 2.0 reaches each feature through an index the mouse hands out at run time, so a fixed byte template cannot prove it never reaches DFU (feature 0x00C0-0x00C3, 0x00D0, Centurion 0x010A), device reset (0x1802), OOB state (0x1805) or force pairing (0x1500). Logitech drivers stay device.mjs (device-library/logitech-hidpp-mouse filters those ids in code).
